dedupe_keys.name: nist cybersecurity framework manufacturing profile example implementation datasets process control and collaborative robotics testbeds

description: These are the experiment data files from the NIST Cybersecurity for Smart Manufacturing Systems testbed, produced for the example implementations of the Cybersecurity Framework Manufacturing Profile at the low security level. The NIST landing page lists files for two testbed systems: a process control system that emulates continuous manufacturing such as chemical production, and a collaborative robotics system of two robot arms doing machine tending. For each experiment (for example baseline, least privilege, firewall, historian, vulnerability scanning, antivirus, backup, VPN and syslog) it gives KPI and measurement files showing how each security measure changed process performance. The NIST data record for the discrete-based system (DOI 10.18434/M32072, version 1.0.1, May 2019, contact Timothy Zimmerman) says it holds all raw and processed measurement data and supplements NIST IR 8183A. Files are free under the NIST licence. Coverage is two laboratory testbeds. Caveats: the landing page says it is no longer updated, and file formats and sizes are not stated on the pages read. For simulation it gives measured performance impacts of security controls on control loops and robot cells, to calibrate cyber-physical models of manufacturing plants. Related catalogue records include the NIST Smart Manufacturing Systems test bed data and the ICS SCADA cyber kit testbed traffic.
